Overview

Building a focused product around a real workflow.

Sentinel is a focused clinical companion designed around the cognitive demands of medical work. Short assessments create a baseline and help professionals notice changes in reaction, memory and typing performance across demanding shifts.

Key capabilities
01

Reaction, memory and typing tests establish cognitive baselines

02

Shift-fatigue tracking surfaces performance changes

03

Gemini-powered feedback translates results into useful guidance

04

A clear dashboard shaped around medical professional workflows
